entity-sentence.text: Karon is a dental clinic management app built for small clinics with 1 to 2 chairs, starting in the Philippines.

booking-link.text: Share a booking link for patient requests.

booking-inbox.text: Review booking requests in one inbox.

today-board.text: Run today's visits from one screen.

secure-staff-access.text: Owners control staff access to clinic work.

services-catalog.text: Keep services, prices, and visit durations together.

headline-today-screen.text: Bookings land on your Today screen, not in your Messenger chats.

headline-one-inbox.text: Every booking lands in one inbox, not in your Messenger chats.

subhead-founding.text: Built at the chair with founding clinics.

unsaved-work-protected.text: Protect pending chair work before sign-out.
